_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Robert Willis (1799-1878): The Works of William Harvey (Sydenham Society, 1847) and its De Motu Cordis in the Everyman reprint. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Willis, Member of the Royal College of Surgeons'; that form is recorded.
